title: FairSplit
problem: Shared electricity bills are often split equally or by average usage, which becomes unfair under progressive tariff systems where higher consumption is charged at higher rates. This leaves low-usage tenants subsidizing heavier consumers and makes the final bill difficult to justify.
solution: FairSplit calculates the exact bill using tariff bands and fairly distributes costs based on each sub-meter's usage, while separately accounting for shared consumption. Every tenant receives a transparent, itemized breakdown that exactly matches the utility bill.

title: Huddle
problem: Group collaboration often requires switching between messaging apps, file-sharing platforms, document editors, and other tools. Students and teams working together on assignments, presentations, research, or projects can quickly end up with fragmented conversations, scattered files, and unnecessary setup.
solution: Huddle provides a temporary collaborative workspace where groups can chat, share files, and work together in real time from a single session. Users can quickly start or join a room, invite others, collaborate while they work, and export the conversation when needed without relying on a permanent workspace.
